newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ in Indonesia telecoms financing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ in Indonesia telecoms financing.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) said on Wesdnesday that it had completed a US$480 million limited recourse project finance facility for one of Indonesia's major telecommunications projects, P.T. Mitra Global Telekomunikasi Indonesia (MGTI).
ANZ said ANZ Investment was the joint lead arranger of the project financing, together with Dai-ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Together the banks arranged, underwrote and syndicated the transaction to a group of 22 international banks.

MGTI is a joint venture formed by a consortium comprising PT Widya Duta Infotel, P.T. Indosat, Telstra Corp Ltd, Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, Sumitomo Corp and Itochu Corp, to design, construct, test and place in service 400,000 new telephone lines and related primary exchanges in the Central Java Territory of Indonesia.
ANZ said the total financing packaging for MGTI consisted of US$340 million of base equity, US$68 million contingent equity and US$480 million of limited recourse project debt.
